Unfortunately, I am out sick, but I believe you will be able to follow the notes linked here to work through the notes on your own, and then do the assignment please.  The lesson is using the 3 log formulas we learned last time to solve log problems and check for extraneous solutions.  Please help each other understand.  I believe in you!

We will check the 2 homeworks next class (this one and the one that was due today).

Take care,

Bad Habetz

children.title: Day 4 - Exponential Growth & Decay & Regression (5/4-5)
Notes & Assignment
children.content:
Hello Dear 4th Period,

I know this is getting ridiculous that I'm still out.  I'm going to be fine. . .it's some sort of mean virus that has now gone from my throat to my head and I'm still feeling very lousy.  I appreciate you soldiering on without me!  Please help each other learn and just hang on to all of your assignments and keep bringing them to class and I will answer questions when I return.  Don't let yourself get behind.  Keep up with the assignments. . .you all know there are classmates that can help if you are struggling.  Don't hesistate to ask for help.  For today. . .

1.  The sub will give you the notes template.  Please work through it using the filled out notes below as needed, but you will only learn it if you try it yourself. . .in other words, don't just copy the template and not actually learn anything.  Then you'll be stumped on the assignment.

Notes

2.  The sub will then give you the assignment.

Assignment

Take care and I REALLY hope to see you all on Wednesday!

Peace,

Bad Habetz :-)
